requirements.label: Mechanical protection
requirements.value: High transport stress: index ≥ 65, ≤ 20 Gelbo pinholes

why: Water activity 0.18 against 75 % RH outside means the product gains moisture and loses quality at aw 0.45, so WVTR must stay at or below 1.8 g/m²·day (38 °C, 90 % RH) for 120 days.
34 % fat with high oxidation sensitivity tolerates about 200 mg O₂/kg, so OTR must stay at or below 6.7 cc/m²·day·atm (23 °C) for 120 days.
Fat plus light sensitivity makes photo-oxidation likely, so an opaque or metallised layer is required.
34 % fat can contaminate the seal jaws, so the sealant must seal through contamination (mLLDPE or ionomer).
High transport stress allows at most 20 Gelbo flex pinholes, which rules out the more crack-prone barrier laminates.
No candidate met every constraint and your 120-day target, so BOPE 25 / PE-EVOH-PE coex 50 (recycle-ready PE) is the closest option (estimated 58–108 days). Review the flagged requirements.
